Lesson from the book of Genesis

℟. To dress it and to keep it.

Lesson II

Gen 2:19-20

And the Lord God having formed out of the ground all the beasts of the earth, and all the fowls of the air, brought them to Adam to see what he would call them: for whatsoever Adam called any living creature the same is its name. Gen 2:21-24

Then the Lord God cast a deep sleep upon Adam: and when he was fast asleep, he took one of his ribs, and filled up flesh for it. ℟. And he called her name Woman, because she was taken out of Man.
